items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I knew no of him. I never did work with him. I just knew him as being a musician.

ctx.x: He was playing bass with us at that time. One of the few old ones that I worked with.
I was going to ask you about an old bass player. Did you ever know Johnny Prudence?
Yeah, I knew no of him. I never did work with him. I just knew him as being a musician.
